name: anthropic-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK for exposing deterministic tools, resources, and prompts to AI coding agents.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Writing console.log() debug output to stdout in stdio MCP servers (corrupts JSON-RPC 2.0 wire frames; always log to console.error / stderr)
Omitting isError: true on failed tool call responses instead of returning structured tool error content
Using outdated Server class boilerplate instead of high-level McpServer from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js
checklist: All diagnostic logging uses console.error() so stdout remains pure JSON-RPC
Tools registered via server.tool(name, zodSchemaShape, handler)
